title: Ruleset: story_scenes
description: rules/<id>/story_scenes.yaml: the story's battles, partner scenes and routines (apps/session: StoryScenesRules).

sound.description: A sound of the scene: the bank slot and the sound in it.

outcome_variable.description: The variable the outcome goes to: 255 (-1) defeat, 0 fled, 1 victory.

predefined_variable.description: While set, the enemies are those of the enemy variables.

first_enemy_variable.description: The first of the variables naming the enemies by script id.

enemy_count.description: How many enemy variables there are.

no_enemy.description: The enemy variable's value for none.

defeat_section.description: The section of the map's script a defeat goes on at.

counter_max.description: The highest value of the battles-started and battles-fled counters.

fixed_fight_trigger.description: While set, the battle cannot be fled and the partner does not walk back.

show_name_variable.description: The variable that says whether the next map shows its name.

show_name_never.description: Its value for never, set after a flight.

virus_backup_variable.description: The variable with the form before the virus (routine 2).

target_variable.description: The variable with the species routine 10 evolves into.

operand_variable.description: The variable most routines read their operand from.

tally_high_variable.description: The shop tally's high byte (routines 31 and 56).

no_item.description: The operand of routines 12 and 13 that names no item.

remove_one.description: How many of the item routine 12 removes.

remove_all.description: How many of the item routine 13 removes.

selling_trigger.description: While set, routine 8 opens the recycle shop and routine 14 buys cards.

buying_cards_trigger.description: While set, routine 14 sells cards one by one.

recruits.description: The recruits: trigger first_trigger + species, for count species.

count.description: How many species can be recruited.

new_game.description: How a new game's story starts (main.c: main, map.c: initializeMap).

chain.description: original: clear state and the first map's map-head chain; seeded: data/new_game_story's state without the opening.

death.description: The death the story plays (partner_impl.c: tickDeathCondition; doo2.c: the egg box). Without it the partner is reborn at once.

section.description: The map-head script's section a lost life or a death runs (0x4DE).

cleared_variable.description: The variable set to 0 before the section runs.

egg_box.description: The egg box's sounds: when it opens, when the egg moves and when one is taken.

forget_moves.description: Routine 47 (script_common.c: lostAllLives): the reborn partner forgets moves, each with a box. Without it the routine goes on at once.

lines_section.description: The MAPHEAD section of the box's line (0x4D8).

line.description: The box's line in that section.

move_variable.description: The variable the forgotten move's number goes to, for the line to name it.

count_variable.description: The variable that counts the boxes left.

ending.description: The ending's save (main_menu.c: gameClearSave): the versus registry's record it fills with the partner's name and stats (awardMachinedramonData).

gift_species.description: The species id the record takes.

gift_techniques.description: The record's three techniques, as move ids.

from.description: The screen left; any when missing.

previous.description: The previous screen it gets instead.

previous_exit.description: The previous exit it gets; unchanged when missing.
